critical_code_review_comments: routes/ai_coaching_team.py preview logic is clean and idempotent — _preview_used(user_id, coach_key) query on coaching_team_previews via {user_id, coach_key} matches session field usage in message endpoint; preview marker written with $setOnInsert (safe under concurrent double-clicks).

Preview quota interaction is correctly implemented: preview messages increment coaching_team_usage counter (so preview counts against the free 5/day). The 429 daily-limit gate runs BEFORE the LLM call; preview and quota gates cannot collide.
Preview response contract: {reply, remaining_today, preview_used:true, preview_gate:true} — matches frontend expectations (banner + input-replacement).
get_session preview_gate computation re-derives gate on read (not persisted) → self-healing; if entitlements upgrade, gate naturally clears on next fetch.

services/coaching_team_digest.py recipients union of engaged (distinct user_id from coaching_team_sessions) + new_users (last 14d) is deduped and capped at MAX_RECIPIENTS_PER_RUN*2 — protects against runaway during backfills. dedupe_key='coaching-digest-{user_id}-{week_tag}' guarantees idempotency across manual + cron runs.
Preview isolation verified — coaching_team_previews collection keyed by (user_id, coach_key) means each of the 3 locked coaches is independently gated. Good.
Digest dry_run path exits BEFORE build_coaching_team_weekly_digest_email + send_email — no template rendering, no template dedupe collision, no accidental deliveries. Correct.
Frontend testids on CoachingTeamPage.tsx (coach-preview-<key>, coaching-team-preview-banner, coaching-team-preview-gate, coaching-team-preview-gate-cta) are complete and match spec.

Minor observation (not a bug): send_coaching_team_weekly_digest inserts coaching_digest_runs on every call including dry_run — useful audit trail, but consider indexing (trigger, week) if run history grows large. No action required now.
